_about: Differences between OLRC's USLM 2.0.12 sample titles (converted 2023-06-29) and the 1.0 release point 119-134 that scripts/uslm2_check.py cannot explain mechanically. The same check proves (fidelity row) that the 2.x index holds exactly the characters of the raw 2.x files, so each difference below is in OLRC's published data, not in uslm.to_v1. Reviewed 2026-10-30. Two kinds: 'same credit, text changed' (to confirm against the release history in M6e: a delayed amendment OLRC credits before executing it, or a later execution) and 'OLRC editorial change' (a correction, a heading revision or a bracketed note).

/us/usc/t1/s112a.reason: Subsection (b) rewritten between the two files; both credits already list Pub. L. 117-263 § 5947. Most likely a delayed amendment executed after June 2023; to confirm in M6e.

/us/usc/t1/s112b.reason: Heading and text rewritten between the two files; both credits list Pub. L. 117-263 § 5947(a)(1). Most likely a delayed amendment executed after June 2023; to confirm in M6e.

/us/usc/t16/s8018.reason: 2023 file has '(a) In General' and subsections; 2026 has an undivided section with paragraphs (1) and (2). Same credit (Pub. L. 117-263 § 11339(a)); later editorial reorganization or execution.

/us/usc/t49/s329.reason: Subsection (b) text differs ('except that in no case shall the Secretary require' in 2023; 'except that, if the Secretary requires air carriers to provide flight-specific' in 2026, with new (b)(1)(A)-(B)). Credits identical through Pub. L. 108-176; to be traced in M6e.

/us/usc/t16/s1274.reason: 'between the the dam' in 2023 corrected to 'between the dam' in 2026.

/us/usc/t16/s1421f–1.reason: Section heading recased: 'Marine mammal rescue and response grant program ...' (2023) to 'Marine Mammal Rescue and Response Grant Program ...' (2026).

/us/usc/t16/s1468.reason: Section heading 'Regional Ocean Partnerships.' (2023) loses its trailing period in 2026.

/us/usc/t16/s410aaa–75.reason: Bracketed editorial insertion '[, 1996a]' after '42 U.S.C. 1996' added in 2026.

/us/usc/t16/s460nnn–51.reason: The 2023 file places a footnote marker inside a word ('adv1isory'); 2026 has 'advisory' with the marker elsewhere.

/us/usc/t16/s6592.reason: Bracketed reference '[42 U.S.C. 4321]' (2023) becomes '[42 U.S.C. 4321 et seq.]' (2026).
